prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 10 Test 1 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The first chart below shows how energy is used in an average Australian household. The second chart shows the greenhouse gas emissions which result from this energy use. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 10 Test 2 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The tables below give information about sales of Fairtrade-labelled coffee and bananas in 1999 and 2004 in five European countries. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 10 Test 3 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The charts below show what UK graduate and postgraduate students who did not go into full-time work did after leaving college in 2008 Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

prompts.title: Cambridge IELTS 10 Test 4 Task 1
prompts.prompt: The diagrams below show the life cycle of a speicies of large fish called the salmon. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
